Hi Sam —

Appreciate the packet. Quick clarifying questions so we can avoid back-and-forth:

1) Legal name: do you want us to set the vendor as "PrimeBridge Technologies, Inc." (legal) and include "PrimeBridge" as alias/DBA? That's our normal pattern but confirm if invoices should be billed to the DBA or the legal name.
2) Remit: do you prefer ACH or wire? If ACH, we'll need routing + account number OR a bank letter from your treasury team (we can accept bank letter as an alternative to sharing the account in email).
3) PO routing: who should receive the PO when Redwood issues it (email + name)? Can be a group mailbox if you prefer automated ingestion.

Looping in Marissa from vendor ops to expedite the record creation. Marissa — can you confirm our internal minimum fields and expected SLAs for a complete vendor intake (we usually create the record within 48 business hours after receiving completed docs + bank verification).

Hi Sam —

Thanks, Connor. Sam — here's the checklist we need completed to create a vendor/master profile in our system and route POs correctly. If anything isn't applicable, flag it in the form.

Redwood vendor intake minimums:
- Official legal name (exactly as on tax documents)
- DBA / trading name (optional)
- Legal entity type (C-Corp / LLC / Partnership / Nonprofit)
- Federal Tax ID / EIN
- Registered business address (street, city, state, ZIP, country)
- Invoice (billing) email and PO acceptance contact (name + email + phone)
- Remittance method: ACH or wire. If ACH, provide bank letter or completed banking section on the form; if wire, provide wiring instructions and beneficiary name.
- W-9 or equivalent tax form (we have your W-9 attached)
- Company registration/Articles of Incorporation (only required for new suppliers at enterprise tier)

Internal notes / SLAs:
- Record creation target: 2 business days after all required docs received and bank verification complete.
- If we need legal review (foreign entities, unusual tax structure), add 3–5 business days.

Next steps for you: please complete the attached form (fillable PDF) with the exact legal name to use and upload a bank letter if you prefer not to send account numbers by email. We can accept a DocuSign envelope for signatures — I've included a DocuSign link below we can use if that's easier.

DocuSign (optional): https://app.docusign.com/award/12345-PrimeBridge-Onboard
Drive intake folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3CPrimeBridgeOnboarding

Connor/Marissa (internal): once Sam returns completed docs I'll kick off the vendor profile creation and assign a vendor ID.

Best,
